page_title: NEW 1-0 SOU | Newcastle v Southampton 17/08/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+6' Joelinton (Newcastle Utd) was too forceful with his tackle and Craig Pawson interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
90+4' Samuel Edozie (Southampton) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
90+2' The defensive wall does its job and blocks the mid-range attempt from the free-kick by William Smallbone (Southampton).
90+2' Poor challenge! Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) is penalised for tripping and Craig Pawson blows his whistle. That's a free kick to Southampton.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.

90' The ball rebounds out to Cameron Archer (Southampton) on the edge of the box. He immediately strikes for goal, but sends the ball high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Newcastle will have a goal kick.
90' William Smallbone (Southampton) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
89' Tyler Dibling (Southampton) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
89' Southampton take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
89' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Taylor Harwood-Bellis (Southampton), is intercepted by the opposition's defence. It will be a corner kick for Southampton.

87' Carlos Alcaraz (Southampton) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the middle of the goal. His effort, however, is blocked by Nick Pope, who pulls off a comfortable save!
84' Nick Pope (Newcastle Utd) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
83' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Southampton comes to nothing.
81' Russell Martin decides to make a substitution. Jan Bednarek will be replaced by Samuel Amo-Ameyaw (Southampton).
81' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Kyle Walker-Peters walks off the pitch to be replaced by Carlos Alcaraz (Southampton).
80' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Southampton.
79' William Smallbone (Southampton) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.

78' Adam Armstrong (Southampton) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Southampton.
77' Kyle Walker-Peters (Southampton) tries a pot shot from the edge of the box, but it goes narrowly wide of the left post.
74' Yellow card. Dan Burn (Newcastle Utd) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
73' Taylor Harwood-Bellis (Southampton) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
71' That's the end of the game for Ben Brereton Diaz, who is replaced by Cameron Archer (Southampton).
70' Russell Martin prepares a substitution. Joe Aribo is replaced by Tyler Dibling (Southampton).
70' Substitution. Lloyd Kelly (Newcastle Utd) on for Lewis Hall.
70' A substitution has been made. Anthony Gordon is replaced by Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd).
69' The ball goes out for a corner. Newcastle can continue in their attacking effort.
68' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) crosses the ball from the free kick, but it goes out of play.
66' Kyle Walker-Peters (Southampton) makes a rough challenge and Craig Pawson blows his whistle for a foul.
64' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) commits a foul and Craig Pawson immediately signals a free kick.
64' William Smallbone (Southampton) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
63' Joe Aribo (Southampton) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders. Now Southampton have a corner.
62' Southampton enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
60' Kyle Walker-Peters (Southampton) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
58' Samuel Edozie (Southampton) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
55' A cross from the free kick is whipped in by Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd), but one of the defenders steps in and averts the threat.
53' William Smallbone (Southampton) takes the corner but it's cleared.
52' William Smallbone (Southampton) takes the corner.
52' Southampton have a corner.
51' William Smallbone (Southampton) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
51' Ben Brereton Diaz (Southampton) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked. The ball goes out of play. Southampton are awarded a corner kick.
50' Adam Armstrong (Southampton) connects with an accurate pass inside the box and fires the ball to the bottom right corner, but one of the defending players steps in to block the effort.
48' William Smallbone (Southampton) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Craig Pawson saw the whole situation.
46' The referee blows his whistle, Southampton are awarded a corner kick.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Russell Martin gives a chance to Samuel Edozie and Yukinari Sugawara (Southampton) is off.
46' Craig Pawson blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+5' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+4' The ball goes out of play. Newcastle are awarded a corner kick.
45+4' A poorly taken free kick by Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd)! He sends a shot from the edge of the box into the defensive wall.
45+3' Jack Stephens (Southampton) has tested the patience of referee Craig Pawson and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
45' 1 - 0 Goal - 1:0! Alexander Isak laid the ball off to Joelinton (Newcastle Utd), who shot from close range into the bottom left corner, leaving the goalkeeper helpless.
44' William Smallbone (Southampton) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
43' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Joe Aribo (Southampton). Good work from Southampton as they win a corner.
42' The ball possession at the moment is 28:72.

41' Ben Brereton Diaz (Southampton) reacts well to meet the lofted pass on the edge of the six-yard box, but sends a weak header well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Newcastle.
40' A pass from Kyle Walker-Peters (Southampton) is intercepted by Nick Pope and the move breaks down.
38' William Smallbone (Southampton) takes the free kick and immediately restarts play with a short pass.

36' Craig Pawson blows for a foul after Dan Burn (Newcastle Utd) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. Southampton win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
34' Joelinton (Newcastle Utd) commits a rough foul. Craig Pawson stops the game and makes a call.
32' Jan Bednarek (Southampton) sends an accurate short pass. Jack Stephens controls the ball with a fine first touch and is able to come up with a new attacking effort.
30' Jacob Murphy goes off the pitch and Emil Krafth (Newcastle Utd) comes on.
28' Ben Brereton Diaz (Southampton) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
28' Fabian Schar (Newcastle Utd) reacts stupidly and the referee shows him a deserved red card!
27' William Smallbone (Southampton) commits a rough challenge and Craig Pawson blows his whistle for a foul.
26' Sean Longstaff (Newcastle Utd) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
25' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) sends the corner into the box, but Alex McCarthy intercepts it and averts the threat.
23' Adam Armstrong (Southampton) was close to scoring after he unleashed a powerful shot which went a whisker over the crossbar.
20' Flag up against Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
19' Ben Brereton Diaz (Southampton) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
18' Jack Stephens (Southampton) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
16' Yukinari Sugawara (Southampton) delivers a crossfield pass, but the ball is cut out before it reaches its intended target.
13' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) takes the corner kick, but Alex McCarthy reads it well and stops the effort.
11' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety. Corner kick. Newcastle will have an opportunity.
10' A goal, which was scored by Jack Stephens (Southampton), was disallowed due to offside.
9' What was Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
8' Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd) sends over a free kick from long range but the defence is alert.
8' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.

6' Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Craig Pawson with no other option than to blow for a foul.
3' Dangerous play by Fabian Schar (Newcastle Utd). Craig Pawson blows his whistle for a foul.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are on the pitch and Newcastle will have the kick-off.
Craig Pawson got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
